brand.name: Tranqui
brand.legalName: Tranqui Tech Ltd (placeholder: confirm at Companies House)
brand.promise: British-run IT support for small businesses in the UK and on the Costa Blanca. A 24/7 AI helpdesk that fixes most problems in minutes, with real engineers behind it.

services.name: 24/7 AI Helpdesk
services.summary: WhatsApp, email and portal support that answers in under a minute, day or night. It walks staff through fixes, resets passwords and opens tickets. Anything it can't solve goes to a human engineer with the full history attached.

services.name: Automated Patching & Updates
services.summary: Windows, macOS and third-party apps patched automatically after business hours, with failed updates retried and reported.

services.name: Security & Threat Protection
services.summary: Managed endpoint protection (EDR), DNS filtering and email security. Threats are quarantined automatically and our engineers are alerted.

services.name: Proactive Monitoring
services.summary: We watch disk space, failing drives, backups, offline devices and expiring certificates, then fix what we can before you notice.

services.name: Microsoft 365 & Google Workspace
services.summary: Licences, mailboxes, shared drives, MFA, security baselines and starter/leaver automation, all managed for you.

services.name: Backup & Recovery
services.summary: Daily cloud backup of M365/Google data and key devices, with automated restore tests and a monthly report.

services.name: Domain & Email Health
services.summary: SPF, DKIM and DMARC set up properly so your emails land in inboxes and nobody can impersonate you.

services.name: Staff Cyber Training
services.summary: Bite-size monthly training and simulated phishing, delivered and scored automatically.

services.name: Cyber Essentials & GDPR Readiness
services.summary: Automated evidence gathering and gap reports for Cyber Essentials (UK) and GDPR/LOPDGDD (Spain), with an engineer sign-off.

services.name: Tech Health Reports & Advice
services.summary: A plain-English monthly report written by our AI from live data, plus a quarterly review call on higher plans.

services.name: On-site Help (Costa Blanca & partners)
services.summary: When something needs hands, a vetted local engineer visits. Costa Blanca is covered directly and the UK through partners.

plans.name: Calma
plans.humanSupport: Remote engineer support billed at the Rescue rate

payg.name: Rescue
payg.unit: first 30 minutes, then per 15 minutes at a third of that
payg.notes: Remote only. The AI helpdesk triage is free and tries to fix the problem before a paid engineer is involved.

terms.onboarding: £99 / €110 per business plus £10 / €11 per user, waived on 12-month terms
terms.contract: Monthly rolling with 30 days' notice, or 12 months with onboarding free
terms.guarantee: If we miss our response time twice in a month, that month is free
